## Summary

What behavior changes, and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change (or this is docs-only)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, contracts, setup, or architecture changed
- [ ] No secrets, player data, or proprietary game content
- [ ] I did not invent undocumented campaign rules

## Notes for reviewers

High-risk paths (please call out if touched): `.github/`, Dockerfiles, lockfiles, Identity, auth.
